{{Top|leg}}
'''Frman''' was a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] who modified an [[AD-series weapons maintenance droid]] to help with the maintenance of [[Starship/Legends|shipboard]] weaponry. The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] was also modified to work with Frman's [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech]] to make starship repairs easier.
